content.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
content.description: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values (i.e., from left to right, level by level).
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 2000]
hints: I'll use a queue for BFS to process nodes level by level
Exactly! BFS with a queue is the right choice. How will you keep track of nodes at each level separately?
Think about processing all nodes at the current level before moving to the next level
follow_up_questions: How would you do this traversal from bottom to top?
What if you needed to traverse in zigzag order?
Can you implement this without using a queue?
